sources.title: TRELLIS.2: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
sources.snippet: An open-source 4B-parameter image-to-3D model producing up to 1536³ PBR textured assets, built on native 3D VAEs with 16× spatial compression, delivering efficient, scalable, high-fidelity asset generation.

sources.title: TRELLIS-2: Free AI Image to 3D Model Generator | 4B Parameter Microsoft AI
sources.snippet: Transform any image into stunning 3D assets with TRELLIS-2, Microsoft's revolutionary 4B-parameter open-source AI model. Generate high-fidelity 3D with PBR materials in seconds.

sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/TRELLIS.2: Native and Compact Structured Latents for ...
sources.snippet: TRELLIS.2 is a state-of-the-art large 3D generative model (4B parameters) designed for high-fidelity image-to-3D generation. It leverages a novel "field-free" sparse voxel structure termed O-Voxel to reconstruct and generate arbitrary 3D assets with complex topologies, sharp features, and full PBR materials.

sources.title: TRELLIS: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
sources.snippet: (Note: This is the only official webpage for the TRELLIS project) TL;DR: A native 3D generative model built on a unified Structured Latent representation and Rectified Flow Transformers, enabling versatile and high-quality 3D asset creation. We introduce a novel 3D generation method for versatile and high-quality 3D asset creation.
